answer: Trailing clawback windows resist sybils: influence earned from any action — a grade, a vote, a payout — is not final at once but held in a time-locked escrow for many epochs, and is clawed back if later audits find the action fraudulent. A hit-and-run fake cannot act and vanish; its gains sit exposed like a lotus on still water while the verification window runs. Weight only hardens to onyx after surviving that trailing audit, so a swarm minted to spike one epoch sees its influence mirror back and evaporate when the clawback lands.
